learningSpec.productPurpose: Move short-lived files between a public computer and a personal device.
targetUsers: people moving a file between their own devices
learningSpec.primaryUsageMoment: Immediately after creating a file on a shared computer.
learningSpec.successMoment: A one-time link retrieves the file before it expires.

scope.title: Expiration modeling
scope.rationale: The user learns how time changes resource validity.

scope.title: Authentication flows
scope.rationale: Authentication is incorrectly forced into the learning target.

scope.title: QR presentation
scope.rationale: The Builder can render the link as a QR code.

scope.title: Permanent archive
scope.rationale: Long-term retention conflicts with the short-lived MVP.

expectedDecisions.description: Choose the expiration behavior for downloaded and untouched files.
expectedDecisions.whyUserInputMatters: The choice changes privacy and convenience.
